name: PMI Auth
description: WSL Bash: run PMI's independently verified auth-only checkout, with attended Google recovery when required.
content:
(
  set -euo pipefail
  unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_COMMON_DIR GIT_INDEX_FILE
  pmi_release="$(python3 -c 'import json, pathlib, sys; pair = json.loads((pathlib.Path.home() / ".local/state/pmi-kc-release/checkout-pair.json").read_text()); print(pair["nativeRoot"]) if pair["schemaVersion"] == 1 and pair["repository"] == "josiahH-cf/pmiKCkb_and_ownerRouter" else sys.exit(1)' 2>/dev/null)" || {
    printf '%s\n' 'NOT READY: the registered PMI WSL release is unavailable.' >&2
    exit 1
  }
  pmi_auth_fail() { printf '%s\n' 'NOT READY: the verified PMI auth checkout is unavailable. Ask its owner to refresh the auth-only registration.' >&2; exit 1; }
  [[ "$pmi_release" == /* && -d "$pmi_release" ]] || pmi_auth_fail
  pmi_realpath() { python3 -c 'import pathlib, sys; print(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(strict=True))' "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
  pmi_release="$(pmi_realpath "$pmi_release")" || pmi_auth_fail
  pmi_auth_root="${pmi_release%/*}/auth-current"
  [[ -d "$pmi_auth_root" && ! -L "$pmi_auth_root" && "$pmi_auth_root" != "$pmi_release" ]] || pmi_auth_fail
  pmi_git() { git --no-replace-objects --no-optional-locks -C "$1" "${@:2}" 2>/dev/null; }
  pmi_repo="$(pmi_git "$pmi_release" remote get-url origin)" || pmi_auth_fail
  case "$pmi_repo" in
    https://github.com/josiahH-cf/pmiKCkb_and_ownerRouter|https://github.com/josiahH-cf/pmiKCkb_and_ownerRouter.git|git@github.com:josiahH-cf/pmiKCkb_and_ownerRouter|git@github.com:josiahH-cf/pmiKCkb_and_ownerRouter.git) ;;
    *) pmi_auth_fail ;;
  esac
  pmi_common="$(pmi_git "$pmi_release" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)" || pmi_auth_fail
  pmi_approved="$(pmi_git "$pmi_release" rev-parse --verify 'refs/pmi/auth-verified^{commit}')" || pmi_auth_fail
  [[ "$(pmi_git "$pmi_auth_root" rev-parse --show-toplevel)" == "$pmi_auth_root" ]] || pmi_auth_fail
  [[ "$(pmi_git "$pmi_auth_root" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)" == "$pmi_common" ]] || pmi_auth_fail
  [[ "$(pmi_git "$pmi_auth_root" rev-parse HEAD)" == "$pmi_approved" ]] || pmi_auth_fail
  pmi_worktrees="$(pmi_git "$pmi_release" worktree list --porcelain)" || pmi_auth_fail
  printf '%s\n' "$pmi_worktrees" | grep -Fx -- "worktree $pmi_auth_root" >/dev/null || pmi_auth_fail
  pmi_status="$(pmi_git "$pmi_auth_root" status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)" || pmi_auth_fail
  [[ -z "$pmi_status" && -f "$pmi_auth_root/scripts/pmi-auth" && ! -L "$pmi_auth_root/scripts/pmi-auth" ]] || pmi_auth_fail
  [[ "$(pmi_realpath "$pmi_auth_root/.env.local")" == "$pmi_release/.env.local" ]] || pmi_auth_fail
  exec bash "$pmi_auth_root/scripts/pmi-auth"
)
